facts.text: The entry class So101PourEnv is a subclass of gym.Env
So101PourEnv loads a MuJoCo model from the xml_path argument, whose default is scene.xml, and creates MjData from that model
The action space is a continuous Box of six values from -1 to 1: five arm joint targets and one absolute gripper command

The observation space is a Box of eighteen unbounded values: five arm joint positions, five arm joint velocities, one gripper width, three bottle coordinates, three beaker coordinates and one beaker volume
The constructor initializes beaker_ml to 0.0, target_ml to 100.0, max_steps to 500 and current_step to 0
reset(seed, options) calls gym.Env.reset(seed), restores the MuJoCo data with mj_resetData, zeroes beaker_ml and current_step and returns _get_obs() with an empty info dict
step increments current_step, adds action[:5]*0.05 to ctrl[:5], sets ctrl[5] to action[5] and advances MuJoCo with mj_step
Water flow starts only when the bottle tilt is above 30 degrees and is 25.0 * min(1, (tilt-30)/60) times the model timestep, added to beaker_ml
The episode terminates when beaker_ml reaches 150 or current_step reaches max_steps; truncated is always False
The observation concatenates qpos[:5], qvel[:5], the gripper joint position, the bottle site position, the beaker site position and beaker_ml into a float32 array
The reward is minus the distance between the gripperframe and bottle_grasp sites, plus 10*(1-|beaker_ml-target_ml|/target_ml) while beaker_ml is positive, minus 50 while beaker_ml exceeds 110
The bottle tilt is the angle between the water_bottle body's z axis and the world z axis, in degrees, computed from the body quaternion
The scene model sets the MuJoCo timestep to 0.002 s with the implicitfast integrator
The imported model defines six position actuators (shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll and gripper) with per-actuator ctrlrange bounds
The README calls So101PourEnv a standard Gymnasium environment for training low-level control policies
The README says the control layer implements a standard Gymnasium API

determinism.notes: So101PourEnv.reset() restores the MuJoCo model defaults with mj_resetData and draws no random initial state (pour_env.py:34-39), so a reset always starts from the same state; the package's fake is deterministic and ignores the seed.  The same recorded seed and command sequence therefore repeat a state-hash sequence in the fake, but no MuJoCo trajectory was run or compared.

fidelity.engine: custom:So101PourEnv kinematic fake (upstream mujoco scene.xml not integrated)
gaps: kinematic fake only: joint positions move directly to the accumulated control target and water accumulates from a wrist-angle proxy; the fake integrates no MuJoCo rigid bodies, contacts, friction, gravity, position actuators or free bottle/beaker bodies
the upstream So101PourEnv is a MuJoCo rigid-body simulation at a 0.002 s timestep (scene.xml:5); this package's fake is an F0 stand-in and no trajectory was compared with MuJoCo

the fake's bottle and beaker site positions, initial joints and tilt mapping are placeholder test data (fake.py marks each with '# placeholder'); the upstream derives them from MuJoCo forward kinematics and the loaded scene.xml
the fake does not parse scene.xml, so101_new_calib.xml or the mesh assets; it uses the cited 0.002 s timestep for the water-flow calculation but no model geometry
the fake returns a Python list of 18 floats, while upstream returns a numpy float32 array
no rendering: the bridge does not serve cap.world.render.v1 and the fake has no renderer
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: So101PourEnv defines neither get_state nor set_state
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
